input.values: span<const T>; copied into owned storage
input.algebra: Pure deterministic associative Combine(const T&,const T&)->T and two-sided identity

output.fold: Ordered aggregation; empty range returns identity
output.all_fold: Full ordered aggregation even for non-power-of-two lengths
output.get: Borrowed const reference to leaf; value may change after set

constraints.allocation: 2n must fit vector<T>::max_size(); n and storage must fit target size_t
constraints.errors: Bad range/index throws before mutation; allocation may throw
constraints.numeric: Caller must ensure no integer overflow and actual associativity; ordinary floating addition is not an exact monoid
constraints.exceptions: If T assignment or Combine throws during set, rebuild/discard before further use
constraints.threading: Concurrent reads only without writers; Combine must be thread-safe
constraints.lifetime: get references tied to object storage; destruction/assignment/move invalidates assumptions

complexity.space: 2n stored T objects + identity and Combine; dynamic T allocations extra

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative lower bound on owned payload, not a peak-allocation upper bound; excludes container headers, allocator overhead and caller input

evidence.correctness: Reasoned invariants in documentation; not formally verified
evidence.notes: Random sums versus array scans; ordered string concatenation for n=5 and all subranges

provenance.implementation: Written for this project; no source code copied
